spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present continuous with always for a complaint?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] My computer is always crashing when I have an important deadline.
B. [WRONG] My computer always crashes when I open too many programs.
C. [WRONG] My computer always crashed before I updated it.
D. [WRONG] My computer crashes from time to time.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: My computer always crashes when I open too many programs., My computer always crashed before I updated it., My computer crashes from time to time.
